decks.name: Irelia / Blade Dance
decks.strategy: Protect a growing board, ready your units, and contest both battlefields. Published list from Xeno's LA runner-up list.
decks.legend_text:
When you choose a friendly unit, you may exhaust me and pay [Any Power] to ready it.
When you conquer, you may pay [1 Energy] to ready me.
decks.legend_text_html:
When you choose a friendly unit, you may exhaust me and pay :rb_rune_rainbow: to ready it.
When you conquer, you may pay :rb_energy_1: to ready me.
decks.learning_notes: Your legend can ready a friendly unit when you choose it, at the cost of exhausting the legend and paying one power. A conquest can ready the legend for one energy. Irelia, Fervent gains might when chosen or readied. Plan resources for these separate triggers; movement draws from Stellacorn Herder and equipment-granted Ganking can extend a scoring turn.

decks.name: Master Yi / Wuju
decks.strategy: Build a sturdy army and strengthen it before committing to combat. Published list from SWAGALISK's LA top-eight list.
decks.legend_text: While a friendly unit defends alone, it gets +2 Might.
decks.legend_text_html: While a friendly unit defends alone, it gets +2 :rb_might:.
decks.learning_notes: Wuju Bladesman gives a unit defending alone +2 might. Leaving a single defender can therefore be stronger than its printed number suggests. First Mate readies another unit; Punch First and Discipline change combat totals. Keep matching power available for interaction, and count defender bonuses before committing attackers.

decks.name: Kennen / Tempest
decks.strategy: Draw into a flexible army and find openings with repeated moves. Published list from DSG AwesumRosum's LA best-of list.
decks.legend_text:
When you play a card from anywhere other than your hand, empower me.
[Action] —  Disempower me, [Exhaust]: Give a unit [Assault 2] this turn. (+2 Might while it's an attacker.)
decks.legend_text_html:
When you play a card from anywhere other than your hand, empower me.
[Action][>] Disempower me, :rb_exhaust:: Give a unit [Assault 2] this turn. (+2 :rb_might: while it's an attacker.)
decks.learning_notes: Playing from a zone other than your hand empowers the legend; its Action spends empowerment and exhausts it to grant Assault 2 for the turn. Lightning Rush fills the trash, Flow lets spells be played there, and Rhasa becomes cheaper as the trash grows. Order your off-hand plays, attacks, and trash recycling deliberately.

decks.name: Kai'Sa / Void Control
decks.strategy: Control enemy units with damage, then deploy large finishers. Historical published list from Sinzari's Vancouver list (May 2026).
decks.legend_text: [Exhaust]: [Reaction] — [Add] [Any Power]. Use only to play spells. (Abilities that add resources can't be reacted to.)
decks.legend_text_html: :rb_exhaust:: [Reaction] — [Add] :rb_rune_rainbow:. Use only to play spells. (Abilities that add resources can't be reacted to.)
decks.learning_notes: The legend exhausts to add one flexible power usable only for spells. Survivor draws when it conquers, not simply when it attacks. Damage spells can clear a battlefield; Stupefy draws and reduces might, while Watchful Sentry draws on death. Save resources for reactions and avoid treating the historic list as a current metagame recommendation.
